The Dexterous AI Group (DexAI) is hiring a System Engineer with deep electrical engineering expertise and hands-on experience leading the design and development of electronic sensing systems. Our group invents tactile sensors for robotic systems. You will lead the electrical architecture, design, integration, and validation needed to turn early concepts into reliable systems that perform consistently under real operating conditions. You will stay close to the hardware: designing electronic systems and circuits, reviewing board layouts, bringing up prototypes, investigating failures, and guiding design improvements. Working with sensor, mechanical, firmware, and software engineers, you will take systems from functional prototypes toward production readiness. Prior sensor experience is helpful; strong electrical engineering fundamentals and demonstrated electronic system design leadership are essential. What You Will Do Lead electrical system architecture. Translate product goals into electrical requirements, interface specifications, and measurable performance targets. Make architectural trade-offs across signal quality, bandwidth, latency, power, thermal limits, size, and cost. Design and develop electronics. Own and contribute directly to circuit design, component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout reviews, and board bring-up. Develop the analog, mixed-signal, power, and digital interface electronics that support our sensing and robotic hand systems. Engineer for reliability. Build design margins, protection, fault handling, and testability into the system. Address noise, grounding, shielding, signal and power integrity, EMC/ESD, component variation, and environmental stresses relevant to the application. Lead hands-on debugging and validation. Define verification plans, build measurement and test setups, and investigate failures at the circuit, board, and integrated system levels. Use structured experiments and root-cause analysis to drive corrective actions and verify that they work. Own electrical interfaces and integration. Work with sensor, mechanical, firmware, and software engineers to define interfaces, timing, data acquisition, calibration needs, and fault behavior. Resolve interactions that affect system performance and reliability. Bridge prototype to production. Guide design revisions through engineering validation and production qualification. Partner with manufacturing and suppliers on manufacturability, test coverage, component availability, yield, and repeatability. Provide technical leadership. Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and maintain clear requirements, design documentation, and test evidence. Establish practical engineering standards appropriate to an inventive, fast-moving team. What We’re Looking For Deep electrical engineering expertise. Strong fundamentals in analog and mixed-signal circuits, board-level power design, digital interfaces, and signal and power integrity, supported by substantial practical design experience. Relevant experience. 8+ years of electronic hardware or electrical system development, with 12+ years preferred. A demonstrated record of leading complex electronic systems from architecture through implementation and validation. Direct design ownership. Personal responsibility for circuit design, schematics, PCB design decisions, bring-up, and debugging. Proficiency with electronic design tools such as Altium or Cadence Allegro, and confidence using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment. Prototype-to-production experience. Hands-on experience taking electronic hardware from early prototypes to a manufacturable, production-qualified design, including resolving problems uncovered during integration and qualification. Reliability and test discipline. Experience applying design risk analysis, structured verification, stress testing, and root-cause analysis to improve hardware and system reliability. Familiarity with methods such as DFMEA and DVP&R. Effective cross-disciplinary collaboration. Ability to understand mechanical constraints and firmware/software behavior well enough to define interfaces and diagnose system interactions, while bringing deep expertise in electrical engineering. Practical automation skills. Ability to use Python or similar tools for measurement automation, data analysis, and repeatable verification. Technical leadership and judgment. A record of earning trust across engineering teams, explaining design trade-offs clearly, and driving technical decisions without relying on formal reporting authority. Curiosity about new tools. Willingness to evaluate and adopt useful engineering tools, including AI-enabled tools, with sound judgment about validating their outputs. Helpful Background Experience with sensors, precision instrumentation, robotics, or compact electromechanical systems is a plus. Tactile sensing experience is not required. Candidates from other industries who have designed and delivered reliable electronic systems are welcome. Who We Are

VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement & Optimization. In addition, VML’s specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world’s largest and most awarded health agencies. VML’s global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

THE ROLE

Everything someone experiences when they interact with VML Montréal - walking into our office, sitting in one of our boardrooms, receiving a thoughtful gesture from our team, reading about us in the press - shapes their perception of who we are as an agency.

This role exists to make that experience exceptional. Every single time.

You are the master host of VML Montréal - inside the space and beyond it. For the people who work here every day. For the clients and prospects who walk through our doors. For anyone who encounters this agency at any level. You do not own any one function. You own the experience.

That means you are the person who makes sure our office is a place the team is proud to come to every morning. You are the first face a client sees when they visit - and the reason they feel remembered long after they leave. You are behind the press release that went out on time, the all-hands that ran without a hitch, and the card that arrived exactly when it should have.

The scope of what you own is deliberately broad - and that breadth is what makes this role genuinely interesting. From maintaining the physical space to coordinating the agency's public presence, from preparing a boardroom to organizing a gesture for a client's milestone, every one of these responsibilities is an expression of the same thing: the VML Montréal experience. They all matter equally. What will make you exceptional here is your ability to hold the full range without letting any of it slip.

WHAT YOU OWN

The space and everyone in it You keep the office in impeccable shape for the team that relies on it every day - clean, tidy, stocked. You prepare every boardroom before a client arrives and tidy after every meeting. You welcome every guest warmly and make them feel at home from the moment they walk in. You own the relationship with building management and execute on any changes to the physical setup of the space as directed by the MD. When the social committee has an event to bring to life, you are the one who makes it happen.

Hospitality beyond these walls A great host does not stop when the meeting ends. You maintain a living record of the MD's key client relationships - birthdays, families, significant life moments - and you flag what is coming up every week, organizing the right gesture at the right time without being asked. You are not waiting for a reminder. You are the reminder.

The operational backbone You own the agency's weekly all-hands - consulting every stakeholder, populating every section, managing the rotation lists, and making sure it runs without friction every Thursday. You coordinate the agency's PR pipeline, tracking deadlines and holding contributors accountable so press releases get written, proofread, and sent on time. You are a direct extension of the MD - supporting the local leadership team on everything that shapes how this agency is experienced in Montreal, at every level.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Someone for whom hospitality is a mindset, not a task list

• Proactive by nature - you see what needs to happen and you move before anyone has to ask

• Equally comfortable with the full range of the role - nothing is beneath you, nothing is above you

• Sharp and articulate - you communicate clearly and confidently at every level of the organization

• Discreet - you will be trusted with sensitive information and you treat it accordingly

• Bilingual French/English - fully operational in both

• Someone who takes genuine pride in the details - because here, the details are the experience

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Job Description Summary

As a Calibration Apprentice, you will work within the Facilities Department, responsible for all site services across the Dowty Facilities. Calibration is the discipline that keeps every measurement — pressure, temperature, torque, dimension — accurate and traceable, giving us confidence that our instruments and controls are telling the truth. In an aerospace environment, that accuracy isn't optional: it's what stands between a component and catastrophic failure, so precision here has a direct line to flight safety.
The team's focus is 24/7 support of the facility, production areas, and production operations staff, ensuring Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) across our people and products.
The Department delivers effective planned calibration across all facilities and production equipment — from hands-on instrument and control systems to complex test rigs — performed both in-house and alongside external partners. As part of a small team operating in a fast-paced, highly regulated aerospace environment, you'll develop real technical expertise early, and you'll need to be self-motivated with the confidence to work autonomously.

Job Description

About GE Aerospace

Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!

This opportunity is offered at Dowty, a GE Aerospace business based in Brockworth site.

Dowty, a GE Aerospace company, is based in Gloucestershire. It is a world-leading supplier of electronically controlled, composite propeller systems for A wide range of civil and military applications, including commercial airliners and military airlifters to multi-role seaplanes and marine hovercraft.

Key programs include the Lockheed Martin C-130J, the De-Haviland Dash 8-400 and the Leonardo C-27J.

Operated by a highly skilled workforce, Dowty’s’ in-house production expertise for composite blades includes application of resin transfer moulding processes, which have been continuously evolved and perfected since 1976; and the use of braiding machines that rapidly and accurately apply the blades’ fibre outer layers.

Role Description

The primary purpose of the role is to undertake an apprenticeship 4yr program to achieve Calibration Technician status at Dowty.

This program will include attending college and participating in mandatory training courses to develop the technical and practical skills required for the role. Apprentices will gain hands-on experience in maintaining and improving advanced aerospace manufacturing equipment and systems. You will also complete online training as you progress through the apprenticeship.

You will be supported by your line manager, plus placement managers, mentors, and the wider apprentice network, to ensure you are meeting the requirements of your course and getting the most out of your apprenticeship.

Overview of the scheme

Embark on an exciting 4-year journey to kickstart your engineering career, with an additional 6 months dedicated to completing your End Point Assessment (EPA). This program will include attending Gloucestershire Engineering Training College to participating in mandatory training courses to develop the technical and practical skills required for the role. Apprentices will gain hands-on experience in maintaining and improving advanced aerospace manufacturing equipment and systems. In addition, online learning will be provided for the HNC component of learning by Teeside University. This apprenticeship program is designed to provide you with the perfect blend of academic learning and hands-on experience, setting you up for success in the aerospace industry.

Year 1: Building Your Foundation
Your first year will be spent full-time at college with GET Engineering Training, where you'll gain essential knowledge and skills to prepare you for the workplace. This immersive experience will lay the groundwork for your future success.

Year 2: Balancing College and Workplace Learning
In your second year, you'll attend college one day per week while spending the rest of your time in the workplace. This is your opportunity to apply what you've learned in a real-world setting, working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to meaningful projects.

Year 3:
Your third year will include the HNC Instrumentation course. You will study and progress onto the calibration of live equipment. The HNC study is online and done in conjunction with completing your level 3 study.

Year 4: Becoming a Key Team Member
Your final year is all about diving deeper into the workplace full-time. You'll take on more responsibilities, become an integral part of your department, and actively contribute to the apprenticeship community. During this time, you'll also have dedicated support to complete your HNC and EPA assignments.

At the completion of your studies, you will be awarded an HNC certificate of Instrumentation and Control Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

As an Apprentice you will learn to complete the following duties which is the expectation of a multiskilled technician.

• 5+ years in Platform, SRE, or DevOps roles with deep production Kubernetes experience.

• Strong expertise in GitOps, CI/CD architecture, and Infrastructure as Code.

• Advanced troubleshooting skills across large-scale distributed systems.

• Strong communication skills and experience influencing across teams.

• Experience with Rancher/RKE2 or AKS in production environments.

• Familiarity with policy-as-code, image signing, SBOMs, or regulated CI/CD environments.

• Experience integrating AI/ML-driven automation into containerized infrastructure and DevOps workflows.
